```{r TCGA full cohort}
############################################################
## Step 5. SHAP-based prioritisation for wet-lab DMR panel
##
## Purpose:
##   1. Use the best-performing radial SVM model
##   2. Calculate SHAP values for all 110 DMRs
##   3. Rank DMRs by SHAP importance
##   4. Merge SHAP ranking with TCGA delta beta, validation evidence,
##      other normal tissue background, and whole blood background
##   5. Select a final top 10 DMR panel for wet-lab validation
##   6. Generate:
##        - SHAP importance barplot
##        - SHAP summary beeswarm plot
##        - top 10 DMR tumour-normal beta boxplot/beeswarm plot
##
## Important:
##   SHAP should be calculated for all 110 DMRs first.
##   The top 10 DMRs are selected AFTER ranking all 110 DMRs.
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
options(scipen = 20)

set.seed(123)

############################################################
## Module 0. Load required packages
############################################################

library(data.table)
library(caret)
library(fastshap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pROC)
library(kernlab)

############################################################
## Module 1. Set input files and output directory
############################################################

## Trained ML models from GSE101764.
## Expected objects:
##   model_svm, model_rf, model_glmnet, ml_df, feature_name_map
training_model_file <- "GSE101764_ML_training_3models_110DMRs.Rdata"

## TCGA full testing results.
## Expected object:
##   test_df_full
tcga_testing_file <- "TCGA_full_testing_results_3models.Rdata"

## Final 110 DMR table after other-normal-tissue and whole-blood filtering.
final_dmr_file <- "final_DMRs_after_GSE196696_whole_blood_filter.csv"

## Output directory
outdir <- "step5.3_SHAP_priority_panel_selection"

if (!dir.exists(outdir)) {
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
}

############################################################
## Module 2. Load trained models, TCGA test data and final DMR table
############################################################

load(training_model_file)

required_training_objects <- c(
  "model_svm",
  "feature_name_map",
  "ml_df"
)

load(tcga_testing_file)

final_dmrs <- fread(final_dmr_file)

dim(test_df_full)
table(test_df_full$group)
dim(final_dmrs)

############################################################
## Module 3. Select final model and extract model features
############################################################

## Based on your previous TCGA testing results, radial SVM performed best.
final_model <- model_svm
final_model_name <- "Radial SVM"
print(final_model$bestTune)

# Extract the predictor names used to train the final model
# ".outcome" is the response variable stored by caret, so it is excluded
features_svm <- setdiff(
  colnames(final_model$trainingData),
  ".outcome"
)

# Check the extracted feature names
length(features_svm)
head(features_svm,10)

## Check all model features are present in TCGA test data
stopifnot(all(features_svm %in% colnames(test_df_full)))
length(setdiff(features_svm, colnames(test_df_full))) == 0

############################################################
## Module 4. Prepare TCGA data for SHAP
############################################################

## x_explain contains only DMR features.
## This should be TCGA samples x 110 DMRs.
x_explain <- test_df_full[, features_svm, drop = FALSE]
x_explain <- as.data.frame(x_explain)
head(rownames(x_explain))

## Standardise group order for plotting.
## SHAP will explain predicted probability of Tumor.
test_df_full$group <- factor(
  as.character(test_df_full$group),
  levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")
)
check_dataframe <-data.frame(rownames(test_df_full),test_df_full$group)
head(check_dataframe)
tail(check_dataframe)
############################################################
## Module 5. Define prediction wrapper for SHAP
############################################################

## SHAP needs a prediction function.
## Here we explain predicted probability of Tumor.
##
## Interpretation:
##   SHAP value > 0 means this DMR pushes prediction towards Tumor.
##   SHAP value < 0 means this DMR pushes prediction towards Normal.
############################################################
## Define prediction wrapper for SHAP
############################################################

pred_wrapper_svm <- function(object, newdata) {
  
  newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  newdata <- newdata[, features_svm, drop = FALSE]
  
  predict(
    object,
    newdata = newdata,
    type = "prob"
  )[, "Tumor"]
}

############################################################
## Module 6. Run SHAP for ALL 110 DMRs
############################################################

## Important:
##   Run SHAP on all 110 DMRs first.
##   Then rank all 110 DMRs.
##   Then select top 10.
##
## For quick testing, use nsim_shap <- 10.
## For final results, use 50 or 100.
nsim_shap <- 10

set.seed(123)

shap_svm <- fastshap::explain(
  object = final_model,
  X = x_explain,
  pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper_svm,
  nsim = nsim_shap,
  adjust = TRUE
)

shap_svm <- as.data.frame(shap_svm)
print(dim(shap_svm))

## Expected dimension:
##   number of TCGA samples x number of SVM DMR features
save(
  shap_svm,
  file = file.path(outdir, "radial_SVM_SHAP_values_all_110_DMRs_TCGA_full.Rdata")
)

############################################################
## Module 7. Summarise SHAP importance for each DMR
############################################################

## mean_abs_SHAP:
##   average absolute contribution of each DMR across all TCGA samples.
##   Higher mean_abs_SHAP = more important for model prediction.
shap_importance <- data.table(
  Feature = colnames(shap_svm),
  mean_abs_SHAP = colMeans(abs(shap_svm), na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_SHAP = colMeans(shap_svm, na.rm = TRUE)
)

setorder(shap_importance, -mean_abs_SHAP)
shap_importance[, SHAP_rank := seq_len(.N)]
head(shap_importance, 10)

fwrite(
  shap_importance,
  file = file.path(outdir, "radial_SVM_SHAP_importance_all_110_DMRs.csv")
)

############################################################
## Module 8. Merge SHAP ranking with the final DMR information
############################################################

final_priority_table <- merge(
  shap_importance,
  final_dmrs,
  by.x = "Feature",
  by.y = "DMR_ID",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

# Restore SHAP ranking order
setorder(final_priority_table, SHAP_rank)

# Check the merged result
dim(final_priority_table)
head(final_priority_table)

############################################################
## Module 9. Calculate TCGA delta beta for each DMR feature
############################################################

## TCGA_deltaBeta:
##   mean beta in Tumor - mean beta in Normal
##
## For your hypermethylated DMRs, this should usually be positive.
calc_tcga_delta <- function(feature) {
  
  values <- as.numeric(test_df_full[[feature]])
  group <- test_df_full$group
  
  normal_values <- values[group == "Normal"]
  tumor_values <- values[group == "Tumor"]
  
  mean_normal <- mean(normal_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_tumor <- mean(tumor_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  delta_beta <- mean_tumor - mean_normal
  
  p_value <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(tumor_values, normal_values)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  
  data.table(
    Feature = feature,
    TCGA_mean_Normal = mean_normal,
    TCGA_mean_Tumor = mean_tumor,
    TCGA_deltaBeta = delta_beta,
    TCGA_wilcox_p = p_value
  )
}

tcga_delta_table <- rbindlist(
  lapply(features_svm, calc_tcga_delta),
  fill = TRUE
)

tcga_delta_table[, TCGA_FDR := p.adjust(TCGA_wilcox_p, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  tcga_delta_table,
  file = file.path(outdir, "TCGA_full_deltaBeta_all_110_DMRs.csv")
)
head(tcga_delta_table)

############################################################
## Module 10. Merge SHAP + TCGA delta + final DMR evidence
############################################################
## final_priority_table was created in Module 8:
##   shap_importance$Feature matched with final_dmrs$DMR_ID
##
## tcga_delta_table was created in Module 9:
##   one row per Feature with TCGA delta beta and Wilcoxon results
##  Merge TCGA delta-beta results into the Module 8 table

priority_table <- merge(
  final_priority_table,
  tcga_delta_table,
  by = "Feature",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

## Move the key ranking and validation columns to the front
key_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "SHAP_rank",
    "Feature",
    "mean_abs_SHAP",
    "TCGA_mean_Normal",
    "TCGA_mean_Tumor",
    "TCGA_deltaBeta",
    "TCGA_wilcox_p",
    "TCGA_FDR",
    "DMR_coordinate",
    "chr",
    "start",
    "end",
    "DMR_length"
  ),
  colnames(priority_table)
)

setcolorder(
  priority_table,
  c(key_cols, setdiff(colnames(priority_table), key_cols))
)
dim(priority_table)
head(priority_table)

##Save the final priority table
fwrite(priority_table,file = file.path(outdir,
"SHAP_TCGA_validation_background_all_110_DMRs.csv"))

############################################################
## Module 11. Build SHAP-discovery delta priority score
############################################################
## The final priority score uses:
##   60% SHAP importance
##   40% mean delta beta across the three discovery datasets
## The priority score is only used to rank DMR candidates.
## It is not a p-value or statistical significance measure.
priority_table_scored <- copy(priority_table)
############################################################
## Define a function to scale values between 0 and 1
############################################################

scale01 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    
    out <- rep(0.5, length(x))
    
  } else {
    out <- (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
  }
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  
  return(out)
}

##Convert SHAP importance to a 0-1 score.
priority_table_scored[, score_SHAP :=
                        scale01(mean_abs_SHAP)]

## Convert discovery delta beta to a 0-1 score
priority_table_scored[, score_discovery_delta :=
                        scale01(discovery_deltaBeta)]
## Calculate the combined priority score
## Combine the two scaled scores
priority_table_scored[, priority_score :=
                        0.60 * score_SHAP +
                        0.40 * score_discovery_delta]

## Rank DMR candidates
## Sort the table from highest to lowest priority score.
##
## If two DMRs have the same priority score:
##   1. the DMR with higher mean_abs_SHAP is ranked first;
##   2. if still tied, the DMR with higher discovery_deltaBeta
##      is ranked first.

setorder(
  priority_table_scored,
  -priority_score,
  -mean_abs_SHAP,
  -discovery_deltaBeta
)
## Assign the final priority rank
## priority_rank = 1 represents the highest-priority DMR.
priority_table_scored[, priority_rank := seq_len(.N)]

## rank comparison
ranking_comparison <- priority_table_scored[
  ,
  .(
    Feature,
    SHAP_rank,
    priority_rank,
    mean_abs_SHAP,
    discovery_deltaBeta,
    score_SHAP,
    score_discovery_delta,
    priority_score
  )
]
## A positive value means that the DMR ranks better in the
## combined ranking than in the SHAP-only ranking.
ranking_comparison[, rank_change :=
                     SHAP_rank - priority_rank]
setorder(ranking_comparison, priority_rank)
head(ranking_comparison, 20)

## Original table from Module 10
fwrite(
  priority_table,
  file = file.path(outdir,
    "SHAP_TCGA_validation_background_all_110_DMRs.csv"))

## New table ranked by the combined score
fwrite(priority_table_scored,
  file = file.path(outdir,
    "SHAP_discovery_delta_scored_all_110_DMRs.csv"))

## Direct comparison between SHAP rank and combined rank
fwrite(ranking_comparison,
  file = file.path(outdir,
    "SHAP_vs_combined_priority_ranking_comparison.csv"))

## Select final top 10 DMRs for wet-lab validation
top10_dmrs <- priority_table_scored[
  priority_rank <= 10]
fwrite(top10_dmrs,
       file = file.path(outdir,
      "Final_top10_DMRs_for_wetlab_validation.csv"))

############################################################
## Module 12. Visualization
############################################################

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
top10_dmrs <- copy(priority_table_scored[
    priority_rank <= 10])

## Arrange the selected DMRs from rank 1 to rank 10.
setorder(top10_dmrs, priority_rank)
 
## Create a consistent label for all plots
top10_dmrs[, DMR_label :=paste0("Rank ",priority_rank,": ",Feature)]

## Reverse the factor levels so that rank 1 appears at the
## top of horizontal bar plots and SHAP summary plots.

top10_dmrs[, DMR_label :=factor(DMR_label,levels = rev(DMR_label))]

############################################################
## Plot1: Combined priority score barplot
############################################################
## The DMRs are ranked using the combined priority score: 
#priority_score =0.60 * scaled SHAP importance +0.40 * scaled discovery delta beta

p_priority_bar <- ggplot(
  top10_dmrs,
  aes(x = priority_score,
    y = DMR_label)) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    fill = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.3f", priority_score)
    ),
    hjust = -0.12,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  expand_limits(
    x = max(
      top10_dmrs$priority_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 1.15
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Final top 10 DMRs by combined priority score",
    subtitle = "60% SHAP importance + 40% discovery delta beta",
    x = "Combined priority score",
    y = "DMR"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

print(p_priority_bar)
ggsave(filename = file.path(outdir,
      "final_top10_combined_priority_score_barplot.png"),
  plot = p_priority_bar,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir,
 "final_top10_combined_priority_score_barplot.pdf"),
  plot = p_priority_bar,
  width = 10,
  height = 7)

############################################################
## Plot2. Visualise the two weighted score components
############################################################
## Calculate the actual contribution of each component to the
## final priority score.
## weighted_SHAP:
##   contribution from scaled SHAP importance
## weighted_discovery_delta:
##   contribution from scaled discovery delta beta
## Their sum should equal priority_score.

top10_dmrs[, weighted_SHAP :=0.60 * score_SHAP]

top10_dmrs[, weighted_discovery_delta :=0.40 * score_discovery_delta]

############################################################
## Confirm that the two contributions reproduce the score
############################################################
top10_dmrs[, score_check :=weighted_SHAP +weighted_discovery_delta]

cat(
  "\nMaximum difference between priority_score and score_check:\n"
)

print(
  max(
    abs(
      top10_dmrs$priority_score -
        top10_dmrs$score_check
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


############################################################
## Convert the component scores to long format
############################################################

component_plot_df <- melt(
  top10_dmrs,
  id.vars = c(
    "Feature",
    "priority_rank",
    "DMR_label",
    "priority_score"
  ),
  measure.vars = c(
    "weighted_SHAP",
    "weighted_discovery_delta"
  ),
  variable.name = "Score_component",
  value.name = "Weighted_contribution"
)

component_plot_df[
  ,
  Score_component := factor(
    Score_component,
    levels = c(
      "weighted_SHAP",
      "weighted_discovery_delta"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "SHAP contribution (60%)",
      "Discovery delta contribution (40%)"))]

## Create a stacked barplot of weighted contributions
############################################################
## The total length of each stacked bar is the final
## priority_score.
## This plot shows whether a DMR ranked highly mainly because
## of its SHAP importance, its discovery delta beta, or both.

p_component_bar <- ggplot(
  component_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Weighted_contribution,
    y = DMR_label,
    fill = Score_component
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = top10_dmrs,
    aes(
      x = priority_score,
      y = DMR_label,
      label = sprintf("%.3f", priority_score)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.12,
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SHAP contribution (60%)" = "#4C78A8",
      "Discovery delta contribution (40%)" = "#F58518"
    )
  ) +
  expand_limits(
    x = max(
      top10_dmrs$priority_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 1.15
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Contribution to the final priority score",
    subtitle = "Weighted SHAP and discovery delta-beta components",
    x = "Weighted contribution",
    y = "DMR",
    fill = "Score component"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top")

print(p_component_bar)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir,"final_top10_priority_score_components.png"),
  plot = p_component_bar,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir,"final_top10_priority_score_components.pdf"),
  plot = p_component_bar,
  width = 10,
  height = 7)

############################################################
## Plot3. SHAP summary beeswarm for the final top 10 DMRs
############################################################
## Identify top 10 features available in the SHAP matrix
selected_features_shap <- as.character( top10_dmrs$Feature)
selected_features_shap <- selected_features_shap[
  selected_features_shap %in% colnames(shap_svm)]

############################################################
## Create the feature-to-label mapping
############################################################

selected_label_map_shap <- top10_dmrs[Feature %in% selected_features_shap,
  .(Feature,
    priority_rank,
    DMR_label)]

selected_label_map_shap[
  ,
  DMR_label := as.character(DMR_label)]
############################################################
## Create sample identifiers
############################################################

sample_ids_shap <- rownames(x_explain)

if (is.null(sample_ids_shap)) {
  sample_ids_shap <- paste0(
    "Sample_",
    seq_len(nrow(x_explain))
  )
}


############################################################
## Convert the SHAP matrix to long format
############################################################

shap_dt <- as.data.table(
  shap_svm[
    ,
    selected_features_shap,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

shap_dt[, Sample := sample_ids_shap]

shap_long <- melt(
  shap_dt,
  id.vars = "Sample",
  measure.vars = selected_features_shap,
  variable.name = "Feature",
  value.name = "SHAP_value"
)


############################################################
## Convert the corresponding DMR beta matrix to long format
############################################################

beta_dt <- as.data.table(
  as.data.frame(x_explain)[
    ,
    selected_features_shap,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

beta_dt[, Sample := sample_ids_shap]

beta_long <- melt(
  beta_dt,
  id.vars = "Sample",
  measure.vars = selected_features_shap,
  variable.name = "Feature",
  value.name = "DMR_beta"
)


############################################################
## Merge SHAP values with the corresponding beta values
############################################################

shap_plot_df <- merge(
  shap_long,
  beta_long,
  by = c(
    "Sample",
    "Feature"
  ),
  all.x = TRUE
)


############################################################
## Add the combined priority rank labels
############################################################

shap_plot_df <- merge(
  shap_plot_df,
  selected_label_map_shap[
    ,
    .(
      Feature,
      priority_rank,
      DMR_label
    )
  ],
  by = "Feature",
  all.x = TRUE
)


############################################################
## Arrange rank 1 at the top of the plot
############################################################

label_order_shap <- selected_label_map_shap[
  order(priority_rank),
  DMR_label
]

shap_plot_df[
  ,
  DMR_label := factor(
    DMR_label,
    levels = rev(label_order_shap)
  )
]


############################################################
## Create the SHAP summary beeswarm plot
############################################################

p_shap_beeswarm <- ggplot(
  shap_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = SHAP_value,
    y = DMR_label,
    color = DMR_beta
  )
) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    groupOnX = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 1.2,
    width = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    high = "#D7191C"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SHAP summary plot for the final top 10 DMRs",
    subtitle = "Top 10 selected using SHAP importance and discovery delta beta",
    x = "SHAP value for predicted Tumor probability",
    y = "DMR",
    color = "DMR beta"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

print(p_shap_beeswarm)
ggsave(filename = file.path(outdir,"final_top10_SHAP_summary_beeswarm.png"),
  plot = p_shap_beeswarm,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = file.path(outdir,"final_top10_SHAP_summary_beeswarm.pdf"),
  plot = p_shap_beeswarm,
  width = 10,
  height = 7)

############################################################
## Plot4. TCGA beta boxplot and beeswarm for final top 10
############################################################

## This plot directly checks whether each selected DMR
## separates Normal and Tumor samples in the TCGA cohort.
## Although discovery_deltaBeta was calculated using the
## three discovery datasets, this figure provides visual
## confirmation in the TCGA external cohort.
############################################################
## Identify selected features available in test_df_full
############################################################

selected_features_beta <- as.character(
  top10_dmrs$Feature)

selected_features_beta <- selected_features_beta[
  selected_features_beta %in% colnames(test_df_full)]

missing_beta_features <- setdiff(
  as.character(top10_dmrs$Feature),
  selected_features_beta)

############################################################
## Create feature-to-label mapping
############################################################

selected_label_map_beta <- top10_dmrs[
  Feature %in% selected_features_beta,
  .(
    Feature,
    priority_rank,
    DMR_label
  )
]

selected_label_map_beta[
  ,
  DMR_label := as.character(DMR_label)
]


############################################################
## Prepare the TCGA beta data
############################################################

test_df_plot <- as.data.frame(test_df_full)

sample_ids_beta <- rownames(test_df_plot)

if (is.null(sample_ids_beta)) {
  sample_ids_beta <- paste0(
    "Sample_",
    seq_len(nrow(test_df_plot))
  )
}

beta_selected_dt <- as.data.table(
  test_df_plot[
    ,
    c(
      "group",
      selected_features_beta
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

beta_selected_dt[, Sample := sample_ids_beta]

## Convert TCGA beta data to long format
beta_selected_long <- melt(
  beta_selected_dt,
  id.vars = c(
    "Sample",
    "group"
  ),
  measure.vars = selected_features_beta,
  variable.name = "Feature",
  value.name = "DMR_beta"
)
## Add priority-rank labels
beta_selected_long <- merge(
  beta_selected_long,
 selected_label_map_beta[,.(
      Feature,
      priority_rank,
      DMR_label)],
  by = "Feature",
  all.x = TRUE)

## Set the group order
beta_selected_long[,group := factor(as.character(group),levels = c("Normal","Tumor"))]
## Arrange facets from priority rank 1 to rank 10
label_order_beta <- selected_label_map_beta[
  order(priority_rank),

beta_selected_long[,DMR_label := factor(DMR_label,levels = label_order_beta)]

## Create the TCGA beta boxplot and beeswarm
p_beta_box_beeswarm <- ggplot(

```

## TCGA balanced cohort
```{r}
############################################################
## Step 5.2 SHAP-based prioritisation for wet-lab DMR panel
## TCGA balanced cohort
##
## Purpose:
##   1. Use the best-performing radial SVM model
##   2. Calculate SHAP values for all 110 DMRs in TCGA balanced cohort
##   3. Rank DMRs by SHAP importance
##   4. Merge SHAP ranking with TCGA balanced delta beta and final DMR information
##   5. Build a combined priority score:
##        60% SHAP importance
##        40% discovery delta beta
##   6. Select final top 10 DMRs for wet-lab validation
##   7. Generate:
##        - combined priority score barplot
##        - weighted score component barplot
##        - SHAP summary beeswarm plot
##        - TCGA balanced beta boxplot / beeswarm plot
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
options(scipen = 20)

set.seed(123)

############################################################
## Module 0. Load required packages
############################################################

library(data.table)
library(caret)
library(fastshap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pROC)
library(kernlab)

############################################################
## Module 1. Set input files and output directory
############################################################

## Trained ML models from GSE101764
training_model_file <- "GSE101764_ML_training_3models_110DMRs.Rdata"

## TCGA balanced testing results
## Expected object:
##   test_df_balanced
tcga_testing_file <- "TCGA_balanced_testing_results_3models.Rdata"

## Final 110 DMR table after other-normal-tissue and whole-blood filtering
final_dmr_file <- "final_DMRs_after_GSE196696_whole_blood_filter.csv"

## Output directory
outdir <- "step5.2_SHAP_priority_panel_selection_TCGA_balanced"

if (!dir.exists(outdir)) {
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
}

############################################################
## Module 2. Load trained models, TCGA balanced data and final DMR table
############################################################

load(training_model_file)

load(tcga_testing_file)

final_dmrs <- fread(final_dmr_file)

## Use the balanced testing dataframe
## This keeps the rest of the code close to the TCGA full version.
test_df_balanced <- as.data.frame(test_df_balanced)

dim(test_df_balanced)
table(test_df_balanced$group)
dim(final_dmrs)

############################################################
## Module 3. Select final model and extract model features
############################################################

## Based on your previous TCGA testing results, radial SVM performed best.
final_model <- model_svm
final_model_name <- "Radial SVM"

print(final_model$bestTune)

## Extract the predictor names used to train the final model.
## ".outcome" is the response variable stored by caret, so it is excluded.
features_svm <- setdiff(
  colnames(final_model$trainingData),
  ".outcome"
)

length(features_svm)
head(features_svm, 10)

## Check all model features are present in TCGA balanced data
stopifnot(all(features_svm %in% colnames(test_df_balanced)))
length(setdiff(features_svm, colnames(test_df_balanced))) == 0

############################################################
## Module 4. Prepare TCGA balanced data for SHAP
############################################################

## x_explain contains only DMR features.
## This should be TCGA balanced samples x 110 DMRs.
x_explain <- test_df_balanced[, features_svm, drop = FALSE]
x_explain <- as.data.frame(x_explain)

head(rownames(x_explain))

## Standardise group order for plotting.
## SHAP will explain predicted probability of Tumor.
test_df_balanced$group <- factor(
  as.character(test_df_balanced$group),
  levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")
)

check_dataframe <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(test_df_balanced),
  group = test_df_balanced$group
)

head(check_dataframe)
tail(check_dataframe)

############################################################
## Module 5. Define prediction wrapper for SHAP
############################################################

## SHAP needs a prediction function.
## Here we explain predicted probability of Tumor.
##
## Interpretation:
##   SHAP value > 0 means this DMR pushes prediction towards Tumor.
##   SHAP value < 0 means this DMR pushes prediction towards Normal.
pred_wrapper_svm <- function(object, newdata) {
  
  newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  
  newdata <- newdata[, features_svm, drop = FALSE]
  
  predict(
    object,
    newdata = newdata,
    type = "prob"
  )[, "Tumor"]
}

############################################################
## Module 6. Run SHAP for ALL 110 DMRs
############################################################

## Important:
##   Run SHAP on all 110 DMRs first.
##   Then rank all 110 DMRs.
##   Then select top 10.
##
## For quick testing, use nsim_shap <- 10.
## For final results, use 50 or 100.
nsim_shap <- 10

set.seed(123)

shap_svm_balanced <- fastshap::explain(
  object = final_model,
  X = x_explain,
  pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper_svm,
  nsim = nsim_shap,
  adjust = TRUE
)

shap_svm_balanced <- as.data.frame(shap_svm_balanced)

print(dim(shap_svm_balanced))

save(
  shap_svm_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "radial_SVM_SHAP_values_all_110_DMRs_TCGA_balanced.Rdata")
)

############################################################
## Module 7. Summarise SHAP importance for each DMR
############################################################

## mean_abs_SHAP:
##   average absolute contribution of each DMR across all TCGA balanced samples.
##   Higher mean_abs_SHAP = more important for model prediction.
shap_importance_balanced <- data.table(
  Feature = colnames(shap_svm_balanced),
  mean_abs_SHAP_balanced = colMeans(abs(shap_svm_balanced), na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_SHAP_balanced = colMeans(shap_svm_balanced, na.rm = TRUE)
)

setorder(shap_importance_balanced, -mean_abs_SHAP_balanced)

shap_importance_balanced[, SHAP_rank_balanced := seq_len(.N)]

head(shap_importance_balanced, 10)

fwrite(
  shap_importance_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "radial_SVM_SHAP_importance_all_110_DMRs_TCGA_balanced.csv")
)

############################################################
## Module 8. Merge SHAP ranking with the final DMR information
############################################################

## In your current final DMR table, Feature names are matched to DMR_ID.
## Example:
##   Feature = DMR_7
##   DMR_ID  = DMR_7

final_priority_table_balanced <- merge(
  shap_importance_balanced,
  final_dmrs,
  by.x = "Feature",
  by.y = "DMR_ID",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

## Restore SHAP ranking order
setorder(final_priority_table_balanced, SHAP_rank_balanced)

dim(final_priority_table_balanced)
head(final_priority_table_balanced)

############################################################
## Module 9. Calculate TCGA balanced delta beta for each DMR feature
############################################################

## TCGA_balanced_deltaBeta:
##   mean beta in Tumor - mean beta in Normal
##
## For your hypermethylated DMRs, this should usually be positive.
calc_tcga_balanced_delta <- function(feature) {
  
  values <- as.numeric(test_df_balanced[[feature]])
  group <- test_df_balanced$group
  
  normal_values <- values[group == "Normal"]
  tumor_values <- values[group == "Tumor"]
  
  mean_normal <- mean(normal_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_tumor <- mean(tumor_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  delta_beta <- mean_tumor - mean_normal
  
  p_value <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(tumor_values, normal_values)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  
  data.table(
    Feature = feature,
    TCGA_balanced_mean_Normal = mean_normal,
    TCGA_balanced_mean_Tumor = mean_tumor,
    TCGA_balanced_deltaBeta = delta_beta,
    TCGA_balanced_wilcox_p = p_value
  )
}

tcga_balanced_delta_table <- rbindlist(
  lapply(features_svm, calc_tcga_balanced_delta),
  fill = TRUE
)

tcga_balanced_delta_table[
  ,
  TCGA_balanced_FDR := p.adjust(TCGA_balanced_wilcox_p, method = "BH")
]

fwrite(
  tcga_balanced_delta_table,
  file = file.path(outdir, "TCGA_balanced_deltaBeta_all_110_DMRs.csv")
)

head(tcga_balanced_delta_table)

############################################################
## Module 10. Merge SHAP + TCGA balanced delta + final DMR evidence
############################################################

priority_table_balanced <- merge(
  final_priority_table_balanced,
  tcga_balanced_delta_table,
  by = "Feature",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

## Move key ranking and validation columns to the front
key_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "SHAP_rank_balanced",
    "Feature",
    "mean_abs_SHAP_balanced",
    "TCGA_balanced_mean_Normal",
    "TCGA_balanced_mean_Tumor",
    "TCGA_balanced_deltaBeta",
    "TCGA_balanced_wilcox_p",
    "TCGA_balanced_FDR",
    "DMR_coordinate",
    "chr",
    "start",
    "end",
    "DMR_length"
  ),
  colnames(priority_table_balanced)
)

setcolorder(
  priority_table_balanced,
  c(
    key_cols,
    setdiff(colnames(priority_table_balanced), key_cols)
  )
)

dim(priority_table_balanced)
head(priority_table_balanced)

fwrite(
  priority_table_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "SHAP_TCGA_balanced_validation_background_all_110_DMRs.csv")
)

############################################################
## Module 11. Build SHAP-discovery delta priority score
############################################################

## The final priority score uses:
##   60% SHAP importance in TCGA balanced cohort
##   40% mean delta beta across the discovery datasets
##
## The priority score is only used to rank DMR candidates.
## It is not a p-value or statistical significance measure.

priority_table_balanced_scored <- copy(priority_table_balanced)

############################################################
## Define a function to scale values between 0 and 1
############################################################

scale01 <- function(x) {
  
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }
  
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    
    out <- rep(0.5, length(x))
    
  } else {
    
    out <- (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
  }
  
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  
  return(out)
}

## Convert SHAP importance to a 0-1 score.
priority_table_balanced_scored[
  ,
  score_SHAP_balanced := scale01(mean_abs_SHAP_balanced)
]

## Convert discovery delta beta to a 0-1 score.
priority_table_balanced_scored[
  ,
  score_discovery_delta := scale01(discovery_deltaBeta)
]

## Calculate the combined priority score.
priority_table_balanced_scored[
  ,
  priority_score_balanced :=
    0.60 * score_SHAP_balanced +
    0.40 * score_discovery_delta
]

## Rank DMR candidates.
## If two DMRs have the same score:
##   1. higher mean_abs_SHAP_balanced ranks first;
##   2. if still tied, higher discovery_deltaBeta ranks first.
setorder(
  priority_table_balanced_scored,
  -priority_score_balanced,
  -mean_abs_SHAP_balanced,
  -discovery_deltaBeta
)

priority_table_balanced_scored[
  ,
  priority_rank_balanced := seq_len(.N)
]

############################################################
## Rank comparison: SHAP-only vs combined priority ranking
############################################################

ranking_comparison_balanced <- priority_table_balanced_scored[
  ,
  .(
    Feature,
    SHAP_rank_balanced,
    priority_rank_balanced,
    mean_abs_SHAP_balanced,
    discovery_deltaBeta,
    score_SHAP_balanced,
    score_discovery_delta,
    priority_score_balanced
  )
]

ranking_comparison_balanced[
  ,
  rank_change_balanced := SHAP_rank_balanced - priority_rank_balanced
]

setorder(ranking_comparison_balanced, priority_rank_balanced)

head(ranking_comparison_balanced, 20)

fwrite(
  priority_table_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "SHAP_TCGA_balanced_validation_background_all_110_DMRs.csv")
)

fwrite(
  priority_table_balanced_scored,
  file = file.path(outdir, "SHAP_discovery_delta_scored_all_110_DMRs_TCGA_balanced.csv")
)

fwrite(
  ranking_comparison_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "SHAP_vs_combined_priority_ranking_comparison_TCGA_balanced.csv")
)

############################################################
## Module 12. Select final top 10 DMRs for wet-lab validation
############################################################

top10_dmrs_balanced <- priority_table_balanced_scored[
  priority_rank_balanced <= 10
]

setorder(top10_dmrs_balanced, priority_rank_balanced)

fwrite(
  top10_dmrs_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "Final_top10_DMRs_for_wetlab_validation_TCGA_balanced.csv")
)

############################################################
## Module 13. Visualization
############################################################

## Arrange the selected DMRs from rank 1 to rank 10.
setorder(top10_dmrs_balanced, priority_rank_balanced)

## Create a consistent label for all plots.
top10_dmrs_balanced[
  ,
  DMR_label := paste0("Rank ", priority_rank_balanced, ": ", Feature)
]

## Reverse the factor levels so that rank 1 appears at the top
## of horizontal bar plots and SHAP summary plots.
top10_dmrs_balanced[
  ,
  DMR_label := factor(DMR_label, levels = rev(DMR_label))
]

############################################################
## Plot 1. Combined priority score barplot
############################################################

p_priority_bar_balanced <- ggplot(
  top10_dmrs_balanced,
  aes(
    x = priority_score_balanced,
    y = DMR_label
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    fill = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.3f", priority_score_balanced)
    ),
    hjust = -0.12,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  expand_limits(
    x = max(
      top10_dmrs_balanced$priority_score_balanced,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 1.15
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Final top 10 DMRs by combined priority score",
    subtitle = "TCGA balanced cohort: 60% SHAP importance + 40% discovery delta beta",
    x = "Combined priority score",
    y = "DMR"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

print(p_priority_bar_balanced)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_combined_priority_score_barplot_TCGA_balanced.png"),
  plot = p_priority_bar_balanced,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_combined_priority_score_barplot_TCGA_balanced.pdf"),
  plot = p_priority_bar_balanced,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

############################################################
## Plot 2. Visualise the two weighted score components
############################################################

top10_dmrs_balanced[
  ,
  weighted_SHAP_balanced := 0.60 * score_SHAP_balanced
]

top10_dmrs_balanced[
  ,
  weighted_discovery_delta := 0.40 * score_discovery_delta
]

top10_dmrs_balanced[
  ,

]

cat("\nMaximum difference between priority_score_balanced and score_check:\n")

print(
  max(

    ),

component_plot_df_balanced <- melt(

component_plot_df_balanced[

]

p_component_bar_balanced <- ggplot(

  filename = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_SHAP_summary_beeswarm_TCGA_balanced.png"),
  plot = p_shap_beeswarm_balanced,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_SHAP_summary_beeswarm_TCGA_balanced.pdf"),
  plot = p_shap_beeswarm_balanced,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

############################################################
## Plot 4. TCGA balanced beta boxplot and beeswarm for final top 10
############################################################

selected_features_beta <- as.character(
  top10_dmrs_balanced$Feature
)

selected_features_beta <- selected_features_beta[
  selected_features_beta %in% colnames(test_df_balanced)
]

selected_label_map_beta <- top10_dmrs_balanced[
  Feature %in% selected_features_beta,
  .(
    Feature,
    priority_rank_balanced,
    DMR_label
  )
]

selected_label_map_beta[
  ,
  DMR_label := as.character(DMR_label)
]

test_df_plot <- as.data.frame(test_df_balanced)

sample_ids_beta <- rownames(test_df_plot)

if (is.null(sample_ids_beta)) {
  sample_ids_beta <- paste0(
    "Sample_",
    seq_len(nrow(test_df_plot))
  )
}

beta_selected_dt <- as.data.table(
  test_df_plot[
    ,
    c(
      "group",
      selected_features_beta
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

beta_selected_dt[, Sample := sample_ids_beta]

beta_selected_long_balanced <- melt(
  beta_selected_dt,
  id.vars = c(
    "Sample",
    "group"
  ),
  measure.vars = selected_features_beta,
  variable.name = "Feature",
  value.name = "DMR_beta"
)

beta_selected_long_balanced <- merge(
  beta_selected_long_balanced,
  selected_label_map_beta[
    ,
    .(
      Feature,
      priority_rank_balanced,
      DMR_label
    )
  ],
  by = "Feature",
  all.x = TRUE
)

beta_selected_long_balanced[
  ,
  group := factor(
    as.character(group),
    levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")
  )
]

label_order_beta <- selected_label_map_beta[
  order(priority_rank_balanced),
  DMR_label
]

beta_selected_long_balanced[
  ,
  DMR_label := factor(
    DMR_label,
    levels = label_order_beta
  )
]

p_beta_box_beeswarm_balanced <- ggplot(
  beta_selected_long_balanced,
  aes(
    x = group,
    y = DMR_beta,
    color = group,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.25,
    width = 0.55
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 1.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ DMR_label,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Normal" = "#2C7BB6",
      "Tumor" = "#D7191C"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Normal" = "#2C7BB6",
      "Tumor" = "#D7191C"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TCGA balanced confirmation of the final top 10 DMRs",
    subtitle = "Final candidates selected using SHAP and discovery delta beta",
    x = NULL,
    y = "DMR mean beta value",
    color = "Group",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_beta_box_beeswarm_balanced)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_TCGA_balanced_beta_boxplot_beeswarm.png"),
  plot = p_beta_box_beeswarm_balanced,
  width = 11,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_TCGA_balanced_beta_boxplot_beeswarm.pdf"),
  plot = p_beta_box_beeswarm_balanced,
  width = 11,
  height = 12
)

############################################################
## Module 14. Save all balanced prioritisation objects
############################################################

save(
  priority_table_balanced,
  priority_table_balanced_scored,
  ranking_comparison_balanced,
  top10_dmrs_balanced,
  component_plot_df_balanced,
  shap_plot_df_balanced,
  beta_selected_long_balanced,
  p_priority_bar_balanced,
  p_component_bar_balanced,
  p_shap_beeswarm_balanced,
  p_beta_box_beeswarm_balanced,
  file = file.path(outdir, "final_top10_DMR_visualisation_results_TCGA_balanced.Rdata")
)
```
